ValidationRule.description: New or changed NTE interest, application and guest event codes must identify a four-digit edition. Unrelated edits to historical records are preserved.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(NTE_Event_Code__c), ISCHANGED(Web_Form_Type__c)), OR(ISPICKVAL(Web_Form_Type__c, "Partner / Sponsor Expression of Interest"), ISPICKVAL(Web_Form_Type__c, "Exhibitor Expression of Interest"), ISPICKVAL(Web_Form_Type__c, "Partner / Sponsor Application"), ISPICKVAL(Web_Form_Type__c, "Exhibitor Application"), ISPICKVAL(Web_Form_Type__c, "Guest Registration")), NOT(REGEX(NTE_Event_Code__c, "^NTE[0-9]{4}$")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter an event code in the format NTE2027.
